title: 启用多尺度 DiT 监督 (Multi-Scale Supervision)

standard.summary: 在 DiT 中间层 (4/8/12) 上做 student-teacher
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Runs student-teacher supervision on the DiT intermediate layers (4/8/12)
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 在 DiT 中间层 (4/8/12) 上做 student-teacher 自蒸馏，引导网络学习更平滑的语义空间。需要两次 forward，显存开销较大。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Student-teacher self-distillation on DiT intermediate layers (4/8/12), guiding the network toward a smoother semantic space. Needs two forward passes; VRAM cost is significant. Off by default.
